faq.q: What services does Grid Nova Energy offer?
faq.a: We offer five core services: Solar EPC (end-to-end engineering, procurement and construction), Green Energy Projects for residential, commercial and industrial clients, Grid-Scale Solar Infrastructure for utility-scale plants, Operation & Maintenance, and Energy Consulting including feasibility studies and full DISCOM support.

faq.q: Do you help with PM Surya Ghar subsidy paperwork?
faq.a: Yes — our residential scope includes full PM Surya Ghar subsidy documentation, net-metering DISCOM applications, structural load assessment, and long-term performance support.

faq.q: Do you install solar pumps under PM-KUSUM?
faq.a: Yes. Agricultural solar pumps deployed under the Prime Minister's Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM) scheme are part of our government & institutional delivery.

Four segments: Residential (homeowners & housing societies), Commercial (offices, hospitals, hotels, campuses), Industrial (manufacturing & processing facilities), and Government & Institutional (schools, municipal infrastructure, public-sector facilities).

faq.q: Do you offer maintenance after installation?
faq.a: Yes — every system includes preventive and corrective Operation & Maintenance to protect performance for the life of the installation. Our commitment doesn't end at commissioning.

faq.q: What's Grid Nova Energy's track record?
faq.a: Our leadership team and affiliated branches have collectively delivered 4,800+ street lamps, 330+ 10kW WBREDA schools, 2,350+ PM-KUSUM solar pumps, and 1,200+ PM Surya Ghar residential installations across West Bengal and Bihar.

residential.heading: Energy independence for homeowners and housing societies.
residential.body: We design and install rooftop solar systems for individual homeowners and multi-unit housing societies seeking to reduce electricity bills and gain independence from grid tariff volatility. Our residential scope includes full PM Surya Ghar subsidy documentation, net-metering DISCOM application and post-installation performance support.

commercial.body: Commercial buildings typically run high daytime loads that align closely with peak solar generation hours — making rooftop and carport solar installations financially compelling within 3–5 year payback windows. We handle the full process from energy audit and system design through procurement, installation and ongoing O&M.
commercial.body2: Clients include office campuses, hospitals, hotels and educational institutions across West Bengal and beyond.

industrial.label: Industrial

industrial.heading: Reducing energy costs and improving sustainability metrics.
industrial.body: Manufacturing plants, warehouses and processing facilities carry high, consistent power loads — exactly the profile where large rooftop or ground-mount solar delivers maximum financial return. We work directly with plant engineering teams to minimise production disruption during installation and ensure the system integrates cleanly with existing power management infrastructure.
industrial.body2: The 1.3 MWp EPC project delivered by Grid Nova’s team and branch network for Showa India in Faridabad is the clearest demonstration of that industrial execution capability — a full-scale delivery managed across design, procurement, construction and commissioning phases.

technology.title: Engineering standards, not shortcuts.
technology.intro: Every Grid Nova project follows the same six-stage engineering process — documented, supervised and signed off at each transition.

steps.title: Feasibility Analysis
steps.body: Before any design work begins, we assess the site on every relevant dimension: solar irradiance data, shadow-casting obstructions, structural condition of the mounting surface, proximity to the grid interconnection point, and financial inputs for payback modelling. A feasibility study that misses one of these dimensions can invalidate a project post-construction.

steps.title: System Design
steps.body: We develop the complete electrical design package: module layout optimised for available surface area and shadow avoidance, string grouping, inverter selection, DC cable sizing and routing, AC switchgear specification, single-line diagram and protection coordination. All designs are developed using industry-standard engineering simulation software to validate yield projections against actual site inputs.

steps.title: Procurement
steps.body: We source high-efficiency solar PV modules from reputed, certified manufacturers with proven performance data and bankable warranties. Inverters, mounting structures, cables, protection devices and balance-of-system components are procured against pre-agreed specifications — no substitutions without client sign-off. Robust vendor relationships ensure consistent quality and timely supply, even on multi-site government programmes.

steps.title: Construction
steps.body: Civil works, mounting structure installation, module racking, wiring and conduit installation are all executed to documented quality standards. Our site teams are supervised by experienced project engineers who enforce compliance with both our internal standards and applicable electrical safety regulations. Progress is documented photographically at every major milestone.

steps.title: Commissioning
steps.body: Before handover, every system undergoes a structured commissioning protocol: insulation resistance tests, IV curve checks on each string, inverter functional testing, protection relay verification and DISCOM synchronisation check. Systems are only handed over with a complete test report and operating manual. We don't commission against a deadline — we commission against a standard.

steps.title: Operation & Maintenance
steps.body: Commissioning is the beginning, not the end. We offer structured O&M programmes that include scheduled preventive maintenance, corrective fault response, thermographic inspection, string performance analysis and yield reporting. Degradation is tracked against modelled projections, and any underperformance is investigated and addressed — not noted and ignored.

intro.title: Full-lifecycle capability.
intro.body: Grid Nova delivers every service below in-house — not subcontracted, not templated. Each engagement is engineered for the specific site, client and budget.

epc.label: 01 / EPC
epc.title: Solar EPC Services
epc.body: We manage the full Engineering, Procurement and Construction lifecycle for grid-connected and off-grid solar power plants. From initial site survey through system design, equipment sourcing, civil works, module installation, cabling, inverter commissioning and DISCOM grid synchronisation — every activity sits under one accountable contract.
epc.body2: Our EPC scope includes technical due diligence, shadow analysis, structural loading assessment, protection relay coordination, and documentation packages for state electricity regulatory body approvals. We do not begin construction until the design is signed off in full.
epc.alt: Grid Nova Energy Solar EPC — large-scale installation

green.label: 02 / Green Energy
green.title: Green Energy Projects
green.alt: Green Energy Project — distributed solar installation, Grid Nova Energy
green.body: We design and install solar systems precisely matched to each building’s load profile, roof geometry, structural capacity and grid-interconnection point. Residential, commercial and industrial profiles each demand different engineering assumptions — we model every one specifically.
green.body2: Our delivery includes net-metering applications, DISCOM approval management, roof waterproofing assessment and post-installation performance monitoring. We handle PM Surya Ghar subsidy documentation for eligible residential customers — a process that requires careful coordination between the installer, DISCOM and the national portal.

gridScale.label: 03 / Grid-Scale
gridScale.title: Grid-Scale Solar Infrastructure
gridScale.alt: Utility-scale ground-mounted solar farm — Grid Nova Energy
gridScale.body: For large ground-mounted installations, we provide design and execution support covering land suitability, irradiance modelling, single-line diagram development, inverter and transformer specification, substation design, grid evacuation planning and full project management through commissioning.
gridScale.body2: Grid Nova’s team and branch network has delivered projects aligned with PM-KUSUM component C — 2,350+ solar pump installations across rural districts in Bihar and West Bengal — representing large-scale rural deployment capability under government programme constraints.

government.label: 04 / Government Programmes
government.title: Government &
government.body: Grid Nova’s branch network has delivered at scale under national and state electrification programmes — work that demands rigorous compliance, documentation and on-ground execution across rural districts.

items.d: Grid-connected rooftop solar for schools and public institutions, delivered to government programme quality and documentation standards — including 330+ schools electrified for WBREDA by Grid Nova’s team and branches.

Standalone solar street lighting — pole, module, battery and controller — supplied, installed and commissioned under state and central government rural electrification programmes. 4,800+ units deployed.

Solarisation of agricultural pump sets under PM-KUSUM Component C, replacing diesel and grid-dependent irrigation with solar-powered pumping. 2,350+ installations completed by Grid Nova’s team and branches.

om.label: 05 / O&M
om.title: Operation &
om.body: A solar system performs precisely as well as it is maintained. Our O&M programmes are structured around the principle that annual yield degradation is a management problem, not an inevitability.

items.d: Scheduled cleaning, thermographic inspection, string performance checks and inverter health monitoring.
Fault diagnosis, component replacement and root-cause documentation within defined response windows.
Yield analysis against modelled generation, PR ratio tracking and degradation benchmarking.
DISCOM compliance documentation, safety inspection records and warranty claim management.

consulting.label: 06 / Consulting
consulting.title: Energy Consulting
consulting.body: Not every client needs a full EPC contract from day one. Our consulting scope is available as a standalone engagement for clients who need rigorous technical input before committing to a project.

items.d: Solar resource assessment, yield projection, financial modelling and payback analysis using site-specific inputs.
Shadow analysis, structural survey, grid interconnection capacity check and civil condition review.
Full electrical design package: module string layout, inverter selection, single-line diagram and protection coordination.
DISCOM interconnection applications, net-metering documentation, MNRE subsidy processing and state nodal agency coordination.

ahead.label: 07 / Looking Ahead
ahead.body: As India’s energy needs evolve, we’re developing capability in battery energy storage (BESS), EV charging infrastructure and microgrid solutions — natural extensions of our core solar EPC expertise. These are emerging areas for Grid Nova, not offerings available today, and we’ll formally bring them to market as that capability matures.

pay.title: How you are paid
pay.summary: Only on verified payments. Paid monthly, by the 10th.
items: You earn only when a customer’s payment has reached Grid Nova’s bank account and been checked. A promised payment earns nothing.
If the customer has paid part of the price, you earn on that part.
Each entry in your portal moves from Earned to Approved to Paid, and shows its customer and payment.
Approved commission is paid monthly, by the 10th of the following month, into a bank account in your own name.
Grid Nova sets the rates and shows them in your portal, not on this page. Any change is announced in your portal 15 days ahead.
Tax is deducted at source only where the law requires it. Your portal shows the rate before any deduction is made.
If a payment is reversed — a cheque bounces, a refund is made, a project is cancelled — the commission on it is reversed too.

rules.title: Rules you follow
rules.summary: No cash, no price promises, approved brands, data stays in the portal.

items.title: No cash, ever
items.body: Customers pay only into Grid Nova’s own bank account — by cheque, NEFT, RTGS or IMPS. Never take cash or let a customer pay you or any other account.

items.title: No price promises
items.body: Don’t promise a price, discount, subsidy, approval, timeline or warranty that Grid Nova hasn’t confirmed in writing.

items.title: Approved brands only
items.body: Recommend only the equipment, brands and categories Grid Nova has approved.

items.title: Customer data stays in the portal
items.body: Collect details in person, explain why with the Customer Information Notice, and never copy customer information outside the portal.

photos.title: Site photo tips
photos.summary: On site, in daylight, sharp and unedited.
items: Take them on site, with the portal camera — never upload photos from another site or the internet.
Shoot in daylight. First the whole roof in one frame, then close-ups.
Show everything that can cast shade: water tanks, walls, trees, towers, nearby buildings.
Photograph the electricity meter and the main distribution board.
Keep them sharp and unedited — no filters, no screenshots.

join.loginBody: Sign in to add customers, follow projects and see your commission.
join.openingSoonNote: Applications and the Associate portals are opening soon. To register your interest now, call +91 98747 74440 or email info@gridnova.in.

items.q: Is there a fee to join?
items.a: No. Grid Nova does not charge any registration fee, joining fee or security deposit. If anyone asks you for money to join, report it to us.

items.q: Will I be a Grid Nova employee?
items.a: No. Associates are independent and work on their own account. You cannot sign contracts, quote prices or accept money on Grid Nova’s behalf.
Commission is earned when the customer’s payment is verified in Grid Nova’s bank account. Once Grid Nova approves it, it is paid to your bank account monthly, by the 10th of the following month.

items.q: How will customers know I am genuine?
items.a: Your Grid Nova ID card carries a QR code. Anyone can scan it to confirm your name, photo, ID, level and active status.

items.q: What if two Associates bring the same customer?
items.a: The customer belongs to the first Associate whose complete submission Grid Nova verifies, until the project is completed or closed.

items.q: Can I stop being an Associate?
items.a: Yes, with 15 days’ written notice through your portal. Commission already earned on verified payments remains payable, subject to any reversal.

items.q: Is tax deducted from my commission?
items.a: Only where the law requires it. Your portal shows the rate before any deduction is made, and Grid Nova issues TDS certificates for tax deducted.
